biome_minecraft_climate.title: Biome Climate
biome_minecraft_climate.description: Describes temperature, humidity, precipitation, and similar climate properties for a biome. Biomes without this component will use default values. Temperature affects visual effects like snow/ice placement, sponge drying, and sky color. Downfall controls precipitation frequency and intensity.

downfall.title: Downfall
downfall.description: Amount that precipitation affects colors and block changes. Setting to 0 will stop rain from falling in the biome.

snow_accumulation.title: Snow Accumulation
snow_accumulation.description: Minimum and maximum snow level, each multiple of 0.125 is another snow layer

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature affects a variety of visual and behavioral things, including snow and ice placement, sponge drying, and sky color

biome_minecraft_creature_spawn_probabili.title: Biome Creature Spawn Probability
biome_minecraft_creature_spawn_probabili.description: Probability that creatures will spawn within the biome when a chunk is generated.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: Probabiltity between [0.0, 0.75] of creatures spawning within the biome on chunk generation.

biome_minecraft_humidity.title: Biome Humidity
biome_minecraft_humidity.description: Forces a biome to ether always be humid or never humid. Humidity effects the spread chance, and spread rate of fire in the biome

biome_minecraft_map_tints.title: Biome Map Tints
biome_minecraft_map_tints.description: Sets the color grass and foliage will be tinted by in this biome on the map.

foliage.title: Foliage
foliage.description: Sets the color foliage will be tinted by in this biome on the map.

grass.title: Grass
grass.description: Controls whether the grass will use a custom tint color or a noise based tint color.

biome_minecraft_mountain_parameters.title: Biome Mountain Parameters
biome_minecraft_mountain_parameters.description: Noise parameters used to drive mountain terrain generation in Overworld.

biome_minecraft_multinoise_generation_ru.description: Controls how this biome is instantiated (and then potentially modified) during world generation of the nether.

target_altitude.title: Target Altitude
target_altitude.description: Altitude with which this biome should be generated, relative to other biomes.

target_humidity.title: Target Humidity
target_humidity.description: Humidity with which this biome should be generated, relative to other biomes.

target_temperature.title: Target Temperature
target_temperature.description: Temperature with which this biome should be generated, relative to other biomes.

target_weirdness.title: Target Weirdness
target_weirdness.description: Weirdness with which this biome should be generated, relative to other biomes.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Weight with which this biome should be generated, relative to other biomes.

biome_minecraft_overworld_generation_rul.title: Biome Overworld Generation Rules
biome_minecraft_overworld_generation_rul.description: Controls how this biome is instantiated (and then potentially modified) during world generation of the overworld.

generate_for_climates.title: Generate For Climates
generate_for_climates.description: Controls the world generation climate categories that this biome can spawn for. Each entry is an array of [climate_name, weight] where climate_name is 'medium', 'warm', 'lukewarm', 'cold', or 'frozen'.

hills_transformation.title: Hills Transformation
hills_transformation.description: An array of any size containing arrays of exactly two elements. For each contained array, the first element is a climate category string ('medium', 'warm', 'lukewarm', 'cold', or 'frozen'). The second element is a positive integer for how much that entry is weighted relative to other entries.

mutate_transformation.title: Mutate Transformation
mutate_transformation.description: What biome to switch to when converting to a mutated biome

river_transformation.title: River Transformation
river_transformation.description: What biome to switch to when converting to a river biome (if not the Vanilla 'river' biome)

shore_transformation.title: Shore Transformation
shore_transformation.description: What biome to switch to when adjacent to an ocean biome

biome_minecraft_overworld_height.title: Biome Overworld Height
biome_minecraft_overworld_height.description: Noise parameters used to drive terrain height in the Overworld.

noise_params.title: Noise Params
noise_params.description: First value is depth - more negative means deeper underwater, while more positive means higher. Second value is scale, which affects how much noise changes as it moves from the surface.

noise_type.title: Noise Type
noise_type.description: Specifies a preset based on a built-in setting rather than manually using noise_params

biome_biome_replacement.title: Biome Replacement
biome_biome_replacement.description: Represents the replacement information used to determine the placement of the overriding biome.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Noise value used to determine whether or not the replacement is attempted, similar to a percentage. Must be in the range (0.0, 1.0].

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Dimension in which this replacement can happen. Can be either 'minecraft:overworld' or 'minecraft:nether'.

noise_frequency_scale.title: Noise Frequency Scale
noise_frequency_scale.description: Scaling value used to alter the frequency of replacement attempts. A lower frequency will mean a bigger contiguous biome area that occurs less often. A higher frequency will mean smaller contiguous biome areas that occur more often. Must be in the range (0.0, 100.0].

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Biomes that are going to be replaced by the overriding biome. Target biomes must not contain namespaces.

biome_minecraft_replace_biomes.title: Biome Replace Biomes
biome_minecraft_replace_biomes.description: Replaces a specified portion of one or more Minecraft biomes.

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description:
List of biome replacement configurations. Retroactively adding a new replacement to the front of this list will cause the world generation to change. Please add any new replacements to the end of the list.

Properties:
• amount (float)
• dimension (string)
• noise_frequency_scale (float)
• targets

biome_minecraft_tags.title: Biome Tags
biome_minecraft_tags.description:
Attach arbitrary string tags to this biome.
Most biome tags are referenced by JSON settings, but some meanings of tags are directly implemented in the game's code. These tags are listed here:
birch: Biome uses wildflowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged "hills".
cold: Villagers will be dressed for snowy weather.
deep: Pre-Caves and Cliffs, prevents an ocean from having islands or connected rivers and makes the biome less likely to have hills.
desert: Allows partially-buried ruined portals to be placed in the biome. Sand blocks will play ambient sounds when the player is nearby.
extreme_hills: Ruined portals can be placed higher than normal. Biomes tagged "forest" or "forest_generation" will use normal Overworld flowers instead of forest flowers.
flower_forest: Biome uses forest flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags).
forest: Biome uses forest flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged tagged "taiga" or "extreme_hills".
forest_generation: Equivalent to "forest".
frozen: Villagers will be dressed for snowy weather. Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "ocean".
ice: Around ruined portals, lava is always replaced by Netherrack and Netherrack cannot be replaced by magma.
ice_plains: Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "mutated".
jungle: Ruined portals will be very mossy.
hills: Biomes tagged "meadow" or "birch" will use normal Overworld flowers instead of wildflowers.
meadow: Biome uses wildflowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged "hills".
mesa: Sand blocks will play ambient sounds when the player is nearby.
mountain: Ruined portals can be placed higher than normal.

minecraft:tags.title: Minecraft Tags
minecraft:tags.description:
Attach arbitrary string tags to this biome.
Most biome tags are referenced by JSON settings, but some meanings of tags are directly implemented in the game's code. These tags are listed here:
birch: Biome uses wildflowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged "hills".
cold: Villagers will be dressed for snowy weather.
deep: Pre-Caves and Cliffs, prevents an ocean from having islands or connected rivers and makes the biome less likely to have hills.
desert: Allows partially-buried ruined portals to be placed in the biome. Sand blocks will play ambient sounds when the player is nearby.
extreme_hills: Ruined portals can be placed higher than normal. Biomes tagged "forest" or "forest_generation" will use normal Overworld flowers instead of forest flowers.
flower_forest: Biome uses forest flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags).
forest: Biome uses forest flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged tagged "taiga" or "extreme_hills".
forest_generation: Equivalent to "forest".
frozen: Villagers will be dressed for snowy weather. Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "ocean".
ice: Around ruined portals, lava is always replaced by Netherrack and Netherrack cannot be replaced by magma.
ice_plains: Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "mutated".
jungle: Ruined portals will be very mossy.
hills: Biomes tagged "meadow" or "birch" will use normal Overworld flowers instead of wildflowers.
meadow: Biome uses wildflowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags). Does nothing if biome is tagged "hills".
mesa: Sand blocks will play ambient sounds when the player is nearby.
mountain: Ruined portals can be placed higher than normal.
mutated: Pre-Caves and Cliffs, prevents switching to the specified "mutate_transformation" as the biome is already considered mutated. Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "ice_plains".
no_legacy_worldgen: Prevents biome from using legacy world generation behavior unless the biome is being placed in the Overworld.
ocean: Prevents the biome from containing lava springs if it is also tagged "frozen". Allows ruined portals to be found underwater. Pre-Caves and Cliffs, determines if shorelines and rivers should be placed at the edges of the biome and identifies the biome as a shallow ocean for placing islands, unless the "deep" tag is present.
pale_garden: Biome uses closed-eye blossoms (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags).
plains: Biome uses plains flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags).
rare: Pre-Caves and Cliffs, this tag flags the biome as a special biome. Oceans cannot be special.
swamp: Allows ruined portals to be found underwater. Biome uses swamp flowers (mutually exclusive with other flower biome tags).
taiga: Biomes tagged "forest" or "forest_generation" will use normal Overworld flowers instead of forest flowers.

Properties:
• tags (string[])
